description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class 'I18NImportErrorSearchFilterParams' used for filtering search results related to internationalization import errors. It extends a base filter parameters class and specifies allowed sort fields and filter criteria such as language ID and employee number.

classes.name: I18NImportErrorSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for specifying filter parameters when searching for import errors related to internationalization, including fields for language ID and employee number, with predefined sort options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameter object and sets default sort field to 'importError.langString'.

methods.name: getLanguageId
methods.description: Returns the current language ID filter value.

methods.name: setLanguageId
methods.description: Sets the language ID filter value.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the current employee number filter value.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter value.
